name: Renaissance collage
block: Style: a layered scrapbook collage of cut and torn paper fragments with soft drop shadows
describe: a Renaissance scrapbook collage: torn and deckled paper fragments with white cut-out borders and drop shadows, modern subjects in old-master techniques (oil with sfumato and craquelure, sepia engraving, marble, fresco, gold leaf), a warm ochre, cream and sepia palette
